what: blaze-diagnostics: report rustc E0703 (invalid ABI: found `x`) for an `extern "x"` (fn, fn pointer type, extern block) whose string does not parse as rustc_abi::ExternAbi (FromStr). hir-def recovers with ExternAbi::FALLBACK (signatures.rs:1316,1972, expr_store/lower.rs:1104) exactly as rustc_ast_lowering lower_abi does after error_on_invalid_abi, so the build must stop on this diagnostic; today nothing reports it and the program builds as extern "C". A syntax-level check over ast::Abi is enough.
